platform: RBI (Restaurant Brands International) digital-blue global ordering platform, shared with Popeyes/Tim Hortons in other markets

robotsTxt.note: User-agent: * / Disallow: (empty) - nothing is disallowed. Sitemap: https://www.burgerking.com.sa/sitemap.xml. No robots.txt-based crawl restriction applies to this brand, unlike KFC.

GetRestaurants.purpose: Find candidate restaurants near a coordinate (used for both Pickup discovery and as the general store directory).
requiredHeaders: x-session-id: <client-generated random UUID, not tied to a real account>

responseShape.data.restaurants.nodes[]: {_id, storeId, isAvailable, posVendor, hasMobileOrdering, mobileOrderingStatus (live|temporary_unavailable), hasDelivery, hasTakeOut, hasCurbside, hasDriveThru, hasDineIn, franchiseGroupId, franchiseGroupName, physicalAddress{...}, curbsideHours/deliveryHours/diningRoomHours/driveThruHours (per-weekday open/close), currentLocalTime, distanceInMiles, name}

GetRestaurants.notes: Confirmed live: 15 Riyadh results for a central-Riyadh NEARBY search. mobileOrderingStatus/hasMobileOrdering is the field to filter on for 'can this branch actually take an online order' - isAvailable alone is not sufficient (some entries had isAvailable=false but mobileOrderingStatus=live and vice versa depending on real-time open/closed state).

GetRestaurant.purpose: Single-restaurant lookup by storeId - hours + availability. Used as the branch-existence/availability check (equivalent of KFC's getStoreList branch check, but a direct ID lookup instead of scanning a city list).
GetRestaurant.notes: Response is intentionally thin (just hours/availability) - full address/name comes from GetRestaurants instead.

DeliveryRestaurant.purpose: Delivery-availability + quote check for a dropoff address - this is Burger King's equivalent of KFC's validateLocation.

dropoff.phoneNumber: string (leave empty - never fill for automated collection)

responseShape.data.deliveryRestaurant: {storeStatus (OPEN|CLOSED), quote (QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE|...), nextEarliestOpen, deliverySurchargeFeeCents, quoteId, unavailabilityReason, preOrderTimeSlots, restaurant{storeId, physicalAddress, hasDelivery, hasMobileOrdering, mobileOrderingStatus, deliveryHours, ...}}

DeliveryRestaurant.notes: Confirmed live twice: once returning storeStatus=CLOSED/quote=QUOTE_UNAVAILABLE for a real Riyadh address outside the resolved branch's delivery hours (correct, expected behavior, not an error), and once (moments later, different branch resolved) returning storeStatus=OPEN/quote=QUOTE_SUCCESSFUL with a real quoteId. Uses the -gateway host, NOT the plain euc1-prod-bk.rbictg.com host - verified by capturing the actual request URL, not assumed.

featureMenu.purpose: Resolves the current live Menu document's Sanity _id (data.FeatureMenu.defaultMenu._id), which GetMenuSections needs as its 'id' variable. Called once per channel collection run instead of hardcoding a menu id, in case Sanity content is republished under a new one.

responseShape.data.FeatureMenu.defaultMenu._id: the Menu document id passed to GetMenuSections

featureMenu.notes: The rest of this query's payload (upsell/checkout-donation item content) is not used by this collector - only defaultMenu._id is read.

GetMenuSections.purpose: Full menu structure: sections (categories) -> combos/items, with bilingual (en/ar) names, images, and PLU/modifier configuration. This is Sanity CMS content, NOT store-scoped - it returns the same structure regardless of which branch/channel is selected.

requestVariablesShape.id: string, the Menu document _id (e.g. "9670fe1e-0342-41b7-9f92-a8fb1907120f" - confirmed stable, but re-read from featureMenu.defaultMenu._id each run rather than hardcoding)

responseShape.data.Menu.options[]: sections (_type='section'): _id, name.locale/_locFb (category EN/AR name), showInStaticMenu, options[] (the section's products)
responseShape.data.Menu.options[].options[]: products - _type is 'combo' (a deal/meal bundle) or 'item' (a single product): _id, name.locale/_locFb, image.asset.url, itemSize, itemUnit, options (nested modifier/component tree for combos, e.g. required side/drink choices), and (for combos) a modifierMultiplier tree carrying pluConfigs per vendor (ncr/partner/sicom/...) with constantPlu / sizeBasedPlu / discountPlu codes used by the POS - these are pricing LOOK-UP KEYS, not prices themselves.

GetMenuSections.notes: IMPORTANT / KNOWN LIMITATION: this response contains ZERO price fields (confirmed by exhaustively grepping the full ~250KB response for 'price', 'cost', 'amount', 'Cents', and the exact SAR values rendered on screen - none matched). Live prices ARE rendered on saudi.kfc.me's sibling app.burgerking.com.sa /en/menu page once a store is selected, sourced from a client-side pricing hook (`isPricesLoading` / `.prices` / `price.default` / `price.min` - found by grepping the site's own compiled JS bundles), but the exact network call that populates it was not identified within this session's research time (no request/response pair captured during a full page load+store-selection flow contained the visible SAR values, in either GraphQL endpoint). See collector/price-scraper.js and this project's README 'Known limitations' for how this is handled (DOM-text extraction as a documented, deliberate deviation from the pure-API approach, pending a future session with manual browser DevTools inspection to close this gap properly).

clientGeneratedValues.x-session-id: A random UUID generated per collector run (not a real user/account session) - required header, but the server does not appear to validate it against any prior state.
clientGeneratedValues.x-user-datetime: Current ISO8601 datetime with local UTC offset, e.g. 2026-08-11T10:04:46+03:00

whatIsNeverRecorded: No login/account credentials - this brand's storefront does not require login to browse or check availability.
No real phone number (DeliveryRestaurant's dropoff.phoneNumber is always left empty).
No cookies or device/session tokens are persisted to disk or git - x-session-id is generated fresh per run and only lives in memory.
No payment, cart-submission, or checkout call is ever made.
